text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays to all the good boys and girls out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family's runaway frontrunner, Mejiro Palmer! Today, I'm playing the reindeer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, as a leisurely Umamusume myself,
I shall play the role of Santa~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna pull my sleigh and zoom around delivering presents to everyone's house!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yay!

Around town, I spotted Mejiro Palmer dressed as a reindeer
and Mejiro Bright dressed as Santa.
It seems the two are handing out presents, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The present goes... whoosh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to lose, Trainer.
Even in sled pulling, I strive for 'top speed.'
choice_data_list: Huh? Are you planning to compete?

text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O suddenly flared up with competitive spirit.
Once she's like this, there's no stopping her.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-san, I shall deliver these presents
at a speed that surpasses even yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're fired up! If you're willing to help out,
that'd be insanely appreciated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then~, please take that sled over there~.
Let's run alongside each other.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please get on.
choice_data_list: Wait, in the sleigh? I'm playing Santa?
Wait, in the sleigh? I'm playing Santa?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Naturally. You are the only one who could ever be my Santa. Now then—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Haaaaaah!

Calstone Light O began pulling the sled
with tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I can still keep going! I can run even faster!
Faster than the speed of Christmas bells ringing—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! All the way beyond the Nordic horizon.
Haaaaaaaaaah!!
However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone, you shouldn't rush so much.
Delivering presents is crazy heavy work, and the running distance is long."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're fast for a split second, it's no good if you can't hold out till the end.
Well then, see ya ahead~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah~ Lady Palmer,
you're so fast~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Trainer, I'm sorry.
I didn't realize how different this would feel compared to running normally.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we can't just back down here, can we?
Not as the duo aiming to be the fastest in the Santa world."

"I don't feel like I was really aiming for it,
but since you've declared it so firmly, I guess I've got no choice."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's try again.
This time, incorporating Palmer and the others' running styles.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In addition—I have a "secret plan."
choice_data_list: So you've got a plan, huh? Got it.
So you have a plan, huh? Okay, got it.

text_block_list.text: Then there's no choice but to believe. Placing my trust in Calstone Light O, I get back on the sled.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah!

Her initial speed hasn't changed from before.
However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It starts from HERE!
WOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!

This time, the surge was different. The sled accelerated in the blink of an eye,
and finally—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Right O...!!
Is that speed for real, no cap~?!
Catch up to Mejiro Palmer, and then pass her.

Calstone Light O and I—
had transformed into Santas of light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, that's right.
I can run this fast...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (The proper form for pulling a sled. And—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: If only we hadn't piled up all those presents.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, both my body and the sled feel light.
If I can sprint at this speed, I need nothing else.
Not even the presents.

The secret to ultra-high speed was abandoning the duties of Santa Claus.
However...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa♪
That sled is so fast, so fast! Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text:
Do yer besht,
Mishter Shanta, Mishter Reindeer!

The crowd gasped in awe at such incredible speed.
The snowy course was enveloped in massive cheers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Bright, you got me there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on handing out presents,
I never imagined there was a way to entertain people like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~.
Everyone looks truly happy~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Calstone~ Clap clap clap~

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Trainer, we did it.
choice_data_list: Yeah, all's well that ends well, I guess!
Yeah, all's well that ends well!

text_block_list.text: And so, Calstone Light O showed everyone her fastest, strongest Christmas Run.
And so, Calstone Light O showed everyone her fastest, strongest Christmas Run.

That night, while walking under the illumination lights
with Calstone Light O—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I just can't seem to settle down...
choice_data_list: What do you mean, you can't settle down?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Walking on the Trainer's right side
just doesn't feel right to me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Could we try switching positions,
as a test?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
――!!
These are really easy to walk in.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: When you're on my right, Trainer, it feels like I can snuggle close and walk straight.

Having someone on the right seemed to bring a sense of relief,
as if providing a steadying presence.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's our best position, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Crossing your arms might look just right.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's not as if I can't walk without linking arms, though.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the truth is I want to link arms,
but I just can't bring myself to say it...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —That's how I feel.
choice_data_list: You're saying it, you're saying it...!

text_block_list.text:
Whether the mood was good or what, Calstone Light O
couldn't quite tell.
